1.consolidated_definition: der. Responsable. Que tiene responsabilidad legal. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Una vez existe prueba de que el cliente accedió a la mercancía, entonces allí el banco es liable contra el banco remitente (Tribunal de Apelaciones, San Juan, consultado 30-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
liable adj.
Responsible party. Having legal liability. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. Once there is proof that the client accepted the merchandise, then the bank is liable against the remitting bank (Court of Appeals, San Juan, consulted 30-10-08)
